title: Lift state up to share it

slides.say: Two accordion panels each keep their own is active state. Now you want only one open at a time. How?
Lift the state up to their closest common parent.

steps.say: Each panel now gets is active as a prop, plus an on show handler, from the parent.

slides.text: Remove → pass down → add state to the parent.

slides.say: The parent stores which panel is active, as a number. It passes is active down, and an event handler so the panel can ask to change it.

slides.text: One index instead of two flags: only one panel can be open.
slides.say: Notice the state changed shape too: one index instead of two booleans, so only one panel can ever be open.
